hypothesis: Yesterday's loss diagnoses shared concentrated market exposure, not four independent losses. Causal multifactor state gates, cash instead of anchor fallback, and lagged-loss risk brakes may improve the frozen v1254 downside without changing entry or exit times.
classification: Risk overlays on an inherited-exception strategy, not independent new alpha sources.
missing_state_policy: Required nonfinite state factors force both sleeves to cash; never treat missing observations as a tradable weak state.
selection: Train normalization/thresholds on 2022-2023. Rank 2024-2025 by stress-floor annualized return, worst MDD, minimum IR, weakest standard development subperiod. Freeze three per version before history/2026 diagnostic review. Yesterday's PnL is diagnosis only and is not fit or ranked.

policies_description.all_cash_bad: When state is below threshold hold both sleeves in cash.
policies_description.all_half_bad: When state is below threshold halve both sleeves.
policies_description.anchor_cash_bad: When state is below threshold hold only anchor allocation in cash, preserve eligible v60 sleeve.
policies_description.anchor_half_bad: When state is below threshold halve anchor, preserve eligible v60 sleeve.
policies_description.lagged_loss_brake_bad: Halve both sleeves only if state is bad and frozen baseline's previous five complete-session compounded return is negative. Use only prior returns, never current-session PnL.

native_validation: Any economic/risk survivor remains NEEDS_NATIVE_OVERLAY_NULL until a separately frozen full-strategy native null passes. Inherited v45-null and cumulative multiple-comparison failures are retained. No admission or execution change in this research phase.
data_boundary: Fixed existing source manifests only; 2026 fully consumed diagnostic. No filling or provider splicing.
execution_boundary: Research only. Keep Paper v1254 parameters, allocations, ledger, credentials and all trading times unchanged. No broker construction by the scanner, no submit/cancel.
